content_sections.heading: CSIR NAL Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CSIR NAL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CSIR NAL Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Research Fellow: First class MSc in Physics/Material Science/Electronics with minimum 2 years of research experience, One publications in a SCI Journal and should have completed at least two years of post-MSc., research experience; OR M.Tech in Nanotechnology / electronics with at least 60% marks. Preference will be given to NET/GATE qualified candidates Junior Research Fellow: First class MSc. Physics/Material Science/Chemistry. Applicants should have CSIR UGC NET (Lectureship qualification also eligible) or a valid GATE score/qualification.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age: 32 years Age Relaxation: Relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates. Relaxation of PWD is applicable as per CSIR/GoI guidelines. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by CSIR National Aerospace Laboratories (CSIR NAL), located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, for filling up various research fellow positions under advertisement number 14/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSIR NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Junior Research Fellow and Senior Research Fellow positions combined in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the available posts in this notification?
faq.answer: The posts notified are Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under various scientific disciplines such as Physics, Material Science, Electronics, Chemistry, and Nanotechnology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for CSIR NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving completed offline applications along with necessary documents is 16 October 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach on time.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly through offline mode. Candidates need to download the form, fill it out, and send it by post to the designated address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for JRF posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a First class MSc degree in Physics, Material Science, or Chemistry along with a valid CSIR UGC NET qualification or a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for SRF posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a First class MSc in Physics, Material Science, or Electronics with 2 years of research experience and SCI publication, or an M.Tech in Nanotechnology or Electronics with at least 60% marks.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for CSIR NAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 32 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories such as SC, ST, OBC, and PWD as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive Rs. 37,000/- per month plus HRA, while Senior Research Fellows will receive Rs. 42,000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The selection of eligible candidates for the Junior Research Fellow and Senior Research Fellow positions will be based on their performance in the personal interview process.
